summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of all 7 Airtable-powered pages. All pages successfully load and render real Airtable data. Backend APIs confirmed working (articles=70, podcasts=100, videos=194, events=35, team=11, newsroom=96). All content pages show data-populated cards, titles, images, and speaker names. No empty states or permanent loading spinners found.

integration_issues.issue: Both functions log 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' (2 errors each = 4 total) on every homepage load. Despite these errors, real Airtable data IS rendering correctly in both the 'Real World Insights' section and the Newsroom Slider. Root cause: React.StrictMode (in index.js) causes effects to run twice (mount→unmount→remount). First render's fetch fails (likely due to service worker initialization race or Playwright environment), but second render's fetch succeeds. In production with real users this may be intermittent or reproducible.

action_items: Investigate 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' console errors in fetchFeaturedInsights and fetchNewsroomArticles on homepage - occurring due to React.StrictMode double-render in index.js. Consider adding AbortController cleanup in useEffect to properly cancel in-flight requests on unmount, which will silence the StrictMode double-render errors.

In NewContentLibrarySection, map article description from `description_teaser` field (not `description`) to match the Airtable API response structure - currently the article card shows a generic fallback description.
React PropTypes warning: 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute' - find the element with jsx attribute being passed as boolean=true and convert to string.
critical_code_review_comments: fetchFeaturedInsights and fetchNewsroomArticles in components.js have no AbortController cleanup - React StrictMode double-renders cause duplicate fetch requests. Add cleanup functions to useEffect hooks.
In NewContentLibrarySection (line ~3097), `description: selectedArticle.description` should likely be `selectedArticle.description_teaser` to match Airtable field names.
Service worker (v3) correctly skips /api/ requests - no issues with caching breaking API calls.
All pages correctly use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (no import.meta.env remnants found).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 tested pages are working: /articles (70 items, 30/page), /podcasts (100 items, 30/page), /videos (194 items, 30/page), /upcoming-events (35 events), /team (11 members), homepage Real World Insights (3 real cards), /advisory (hardcoded Ken Banta etc). Console errors exist on homepage for fetchFeaturedInsights and fetchNewsroomArticles (TypeError: Failed to fetch) but data renders successfully. React.StrictMode is active in index.js causing double-render. No service worker issues - it properly skips /api/ routes.
rca_of_issues: Console 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' errors on homepage: React.StrictMode (index.js line 10-14) mounts/unmounts/remounts components in preview environment, causing useEffect to fire twice. First render's fetch fails (timing issue during browser context initialization in Playwright or service worker claiming), error is logged, then second render's fetch succeeds and populates state with real Airtable data. This pattern is specific to development/preview environments with React.StrictMode enabled. Fix: Add AbortController in useEffect cleanup functions to properly cancel pending requests on unmount.
